Name: Elliott's Romantic 10 Heart Event
Author: SaventhHaven
Description:
[b][u]Features:[/u][/b]
- Tweaks in dialogue within Elliott's 10 heart cutscene.
﻿- Choose within the cutscene whether or not you want to kiss Elliott!
﻿- More romantic dialogue.
﻿- Elliott won't forget you're already dating when the cutscene is triggered.
﻿- No more Crimsonfish ruining the mood!
- New dialogue after Elliott's 10 heart cutscene, based on whether or not you decided to kiss him.

- You can decide whether the cutscene takes place in the morning or at night via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Confic Menu[/url] or the mod's config file.
﻿- Valid entry options in the mod's config file are "day" and "night," with the default set to "night."
﻿- In the morning, Elliott's 10 heart cutscene will now be triggered between 7:00a-12:00p.
﻿- At night, Elliott's 10 heart cutscene will be triggered between 9:00p-2:00a.



[b][u]How to Install:[/u][/b]
1. Install the latest version of [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Extract into \Stardew Valley\Mods.
4. Run the game using SMAPI!

To uninstall, just delete the folder [CP] Elliott's Romantic 10 Heart Event.


[b][u]Compatibility:[/u][/b]
- This mod may have compatibility issues with any other mods that modify Elliott's 10 heart event and its trigger.
- This mod is compatible with:
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4668http://]Platonic Relationships[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3590100]CherryChain
﻿[/url]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]AirynS

[/url][i]Please note: these are only the mods I have explicitly tested alongside Elliott's Romantic 10 Heart Event to ensure everything still works properly! If you have more questions about compatibility, please feel free to ask![/i]
